solar_target.p_solar_basis: sum of eight same-source BCR output voltage × current channels, positive output only
solar_target.status: YJ-3D MPPT/DC-DC BCR output-side power; not PV input power

solar_feature_model.selection_policy: fixed policy selected by integrated holdout forecast

unit_calibration_contract.input: enabled role=load component power columns from energy_v2_components.csv
unit_calibration_contract.power_basis: minute-mean voltage times minute-mean current proxy unless configured otherwise
unit_calibration_contract.missing_policy: missing/non-finite/negative/outlier samples are excluded, never treated as zero
unit_calibration_contract.outlier_policy: configured max_power_W is a documented screening limit; without it, a wide robust power-tail guard removes implausible telemetry spikes before state and model fitting
unit_calibration_contract.band_policy: deterministic 1-D two-means for low/active; a log-power second split creates active/high only with >=0.2% source support, >=5 samples and >=14x median separation
unit_calibration_contract.polynomial_policy: degree 1-3 candidate; episode-grouped holdout uses the same active-band p05-p95 runtime clipping as deployment; selection also requires >=10% RMSE improvement, monotonic support and endpoint error no more than 10% worse than the constant baseline
unit_calibration_contract.off_policy: off defaults to 0 W; low/idle uses the observed low-power band when present
unit_calibration_contract.shared_power_band_policy: configured paired feeds may borrow a missing high band from a sibling feed in the same physical unit; local high-band evidence always takes precedence
unit_calibration_contract.date_split_policy: explicit whole dates may be excluded before fitting; excluded dates are never replaced or backfilled

diagnostic_metrics_context.usage: 保留越界电量、原始BCR尖峰和未通过SOC质检窗口的诊断值

soc_saturation.criterion: observed_target_soc >= 1 - 1e-6；预测触顶单独计数，不改变分组

raw_soc_saturation.criterion: observed_target_soc >= 1 - 1e-6；预测触顶单独计数，不改变分组

background_load.method: 固定值取窗口起点或此前最近同工况值；滚动值只使用窗口开始前同工况分钟的中位数，不读取窗口内未来遥测

hierarchical.method: 优先窗口前60分钟同工况中位；历史不足时使用前一天同相位、同一时钟窗口前后容差内中位；再不足回退起点快照
hierarchical.orbit_phase_basis: 未配置轨道周期时以同相位、同一时钟时刻作为代理；不声称已验证真实轨道相位

background_load.background_definition: max(TMEA003×TMEA004 母线测点功率 − 历史可变单机功率层, 0)；用于诊断，不等于独立测得的未计负载

ab_coactivity.method: 同编号PL_n A/B通道；阈值取active_threshold_W，无阈值时取active_power_W的5%且不小于1e-6 W

ab_topology.source_document: ../Data/0010-云尖3D星/新一代通用平台单机方案及硬件使用说明20220315-14点.doc
ab_topology.policy: 同一PL_n的上板A、下板B属于同一物理配电对象；设备数量只计一次，功率和电流按两支路求和，电压不求和。缺失支路保持缺测，不按0 W处理。

solar_structure.policy: 当前模型只能作为负载感知代理；缺失可用发电特征时，不得把负载跟随系数解释为MPPT物理增益。

primary_solar_structure.policy: 当前模型只能作为负载感知代理；缺失可用发电特征时，不得把负载跟随系数解释为MPPT物理增益。

bcr_outliers.policy: 主评测按所用留出模型的99.9%缩尾上限处理；原始尖峰单独保留为异常事件诊断

representative_case.title: 从历史单机功率提取任务的负载感知留出窗口
boundaries: 实际条件曲线由初始V-SOC锚点加TMEA006梯形电流积分得到，不施加放电V-SOC逐分钟映射
72.737%是本窗口电压端点套用7.84 A放电V-SOC表得到的交叉参考，与电流积分终点存在约2.89 pp差异
15条任务由功率序列3点中位平滑并剔除少于3分钟的状态短跳变后提取
BCR输出目标不是PV输入端功率，单窗口不替代10窗口总体审计
SOC主标签要求全部区间通过量程、时间连续性、相位和冻结检查
BCR主能量按训练同一99.9%缩尾上限计算，原始尖峰另作诊断

evidence_boundaries: 多窗口目标SOC为当前锚定加TMEA006积分，只有1个绝对V-SOC端点窗口
历史任务状态不等于可提前获得的任务计划
BCR目标是MPPT/DC-DC输出侧功率，不是PV输入功率
当前部署背景负载固定为起始快照；滚动模型仅为审计候选
A/B供电通道物理拓扑和重复计量关系仍需单线图核准
含越量程电池或母线测点的窗口不进入相应主指标；原始与有效区间条件值仅保留为诊断
BCR主能量按所用留出模型的训练缩尾上限处理，原始尖峰另列
